sourceBook: Milady Standard Nail Technology 8th Edition + Milady Standard Foundations (2020)

question.en: The technical term for the natural nail is
question.zh: natural nail（天然指甲）的专业名称是什么？

explanation.en: Onyx is the technical term for the natural nail, the hard plate that protects the tips of the fingers and toes.
explanation.zh: onyx（甲）是 natural nail（天然指甲）的专业名称，指保护手指和脚趾末端的坚硬甲板。

lockPoint.en: Onyx = the nail itself. Onycho- at the start of a word also means nail, as in onycholysis.
lockPoint.zh: onyx = 指甲本身。很多指甲病名开头的 onycho- 也是“指甲”的意思，例如 onycholysis（甲剥离）。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Structure - Define the Natural Nail Unit

evidence.quote: The natural nail itself is technically referred to as the onyx

question.en: The natural nail is made mainly of
question.zh: 天然指甲主要由什么构成？

explanation.en: The nail is made mainly of keratin, the fiber-shaped protein also found in skin and hair. Nail keratin is more durable than hair or skin keratin.
explanation.zh: 指甲主要由 keratin（角蛋白）构成，这种纤维状蛋白质也存在于皮肤和头发中。指甲里的角蛋白比头发和皮肤里的更耐用。

lockPoint.en: Melanin gives skin its color. Collagen and elastin are in the dermis. The hard nail plate is keratin.
lockPoint.zh: 角蛋白的“角”= 牛角的“角”，又硬又结实。melanin（黑色素）管颜色，collagen（胶原蛋白）和 elastin（弹性蛋白）在真皮里。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Structure - Define the Natural Nail Unit

evidence.quote: is composed mainly of keratin, the fiber-shaped protein found in skin and hair
The keratin in natural nails is more durable than the keratin in hair or skin.

question.en: Where are nail plate cells formed?
question.zh: 甲板细胞在哪里生成？

explanation.en: The matrix is the area where nail plate cells are formed. As long as it stays healthy and nourished, it keeps making new nail plate cells.
explanation.zh: matrix（甲母质）是生成甲板细胞的部位。只要它保持健康、营养充足，就会不断制造新的甲板细胞。

lockPoint.en: The matrix is like the nail's mother: new nail cells are born here. The nail bed only holds the plate.
lockPoint.zh: 甲母质的“母”= 母亲：新的甲板细胞在这里“出生”。甲床（nail bed）只是托住甲板。

evidence.quote: The matrix (MAY-triks) is the area where the nail plate cells are formed
the matrix will continue to create new nail plate cells

question.en: The whitish half-moon at the base of the nail plate is the
question.zh: 甲板根部发白的半月形叫什么？

explanation.en: The lunula is the whitish half-moon at the base of the nail plate. It is the visible part of the matrix; light reflecting off the matrix makes it look white.
explanation.zh: lunula（甲半月）是甲板根部发白的半月形。它是 matrix（甲母质）露出来的部分，光线从甲母质表面反射，所以看起来发白。

lockPoint.en: Lunula = the little moon. Everyone has one, but some stay hidden under the proximal nail fold.
lockPoint.zh: 甲半月的“半月”= 半个月亮。人人都有，但有些比较短，藏在近端甲襞下面看不见。

evidence.quote: The visible part of the matrix that extends from underneath the living skin is called the lunula.
Everyone has a lunula, but not all lunulas are visible

question.en: Dead, colorless tissue attached to the nail plate is the
question.zh: 附着在甲板上、无色的死组织叫什么？

explanation.en: The cuticle is nonliving, colorless tissue stuck to the nail plate. It forms a seal that keeps germs from getting under the skin.
explanation.zh: cuticle（甲小皮）是粘在甲板上的无色死组织。它形成一道密封，防止病菌钻到皮肤下面。

lockPoint.en: Of these four, only the cuticle is dead. It rides out on top of the plate as the nail grows.
lockPoint.zh: 四个选项里只有 cuticle（甲小皮）是死的；eponychium、hyponychium 和侧甲襞都是活皮肤。指甲往外长时，甲小皮就贴在甲板上被带出来。

evidence.quote: The cuticle (KYOO-tih-kul) is the nonliving, colorless tissue attached to the nail plate
The cuticle forms an important seal between the PNF and nail plate

question.en: Which living tissue makes the cuticle?
question.zh: 哪种活组织生成甲小皮（cuticle）？

explanation.en: The eponychium is the living skin on the underside of the proximal nail fold. It makes the cuticle. The cuticle is dead; the eponychium is alive.
explanation.zh: eponychium（甲上皮）是近端甲襞（proximal nail fold）底面的活皮肤，甲小皮就是它生成的。甲小皮是死的，甲上皮是活的。

lockPoint.en: Epi- = on top: the eponychium sits on the nail base. The matrix makes the plate, not the cuticle.
lockPoint.zh: epi- = 在上面：eponychium（甲上皮）盖在指甲根部上面。matrix（甲母质）造的是甲板，不是甲小皮。

evidence.quote: the eponychium is the underside of the proximal nail fold and is the living tissue that makes the cuticle

question.en: The thickened skin between the fingertip and the free edge is the
question.zh: 指尖与游离缘之间那层稍厚的皮肤叫什么？

explanation.en: The hyponychium forms a barrier that keeps germs out of the nail bed. If it is damaged, the plate can separate from the bed and infection can start.
explanation.zh: hyponychium（甲下皮）形成一道屏障，阻止病菌侵入甲床。如果它受损，甲板可能与甲床分离，甲下就可能感染。

lockPoint.en: Hypo- = under, epi- = on top. Hyponychium: under the nail tip. Eponychium: at the nail base.
lockPoint.zh: hypo- = 在下面，epi- = 在上面。hyponychium（甲下皮）在指甲尖下面；eponychium（甲上皮）在指甲根部。

evidence.quote: The hyponychium (hy-poh-NIK-ee-um) is the slightly thickened layer of skin that lies between the fingertip and the free edge of the nail plate.
when it is damaged, the nail plate can separate from the nail bed

question.en: Nail polish is applied to the
question.zh: 指甲油涂在哪里？

explanation.en: Polish goes on the nail plate, the hard keratin plate on top. The nail bed is the living skin under the plate.
explanation.zh: 指甲油涂在 nail plate（甲板）上，也就是上面那层坚硬的角蛋白板。nail bed（甲床）是甲板下面的活皮肤。

lockPoint.en: The bed is living skin full of nerves; polish never touches it.
lockPoint.zh: 甲床是布满神经的活皮肤，指甲油根本碰不到它。

evidence.quote: nail polish is applied to the nail plate, not the nail bed
The nail bed (NAYL BED) is the portion of living skin that supports the nail plate
The nail bed contains many nerves

question.en: Why does the nail bed look pink?
question.zh: 为什么甲床看起来是粉色的？

choices.en: It is rich in blood vessels.

explanation.en: The nail bed is richly supplied with blood vessels, so it looks pink under the plate, from the lunula to just before the free edge.
explanation.zh: nail bed（甲床）血管丰富，所以从甲半月到游离缘之前，透过甲板看起来是粉色的。

lockPoint.en: Press on a nail: the pink fades as blood is pushed away, then returns when you let go.
lockPoint.zh: 按一下指甲：血被挤走，粉色变白；一松手血流回来，又变粉。

evidence.quote: Because it is richly supplied with blood vessels, the area under the nail plate can have a pinkish appearance

question.en: What thin tissue attaches the nail plate to the nail bed?
question.zh: 哪层薄组织把甲板连接在甲床上？

explanation.en: The bed epithelium is a thin layer of tissue that attaches the nail plate to the nail bed. It helps guide the plate along the bed as it grows.
explanation.zh: bed epithelium（甲床上皮）是一层薄组织，把甲板连接在甲床上，并在指甲生长时引导甲板沿着甲床向前移动。

lockPoint.en: Think of a sliding door's track: it holds the door on and guides it as it slides.
lockPoint.zh: 想想推拉门的轨道：既把门固定住，又引导门往前滑。甲床上皮对甲板就是这样。

evidence.quote: is attached to the nail plate by a thin layer of tissue called the bed epithelium
The bed epithelium helps guide the nail plate along the nail bed as it grows.

question.en: What attaches the nail bed and matrix to the bone underneath?
question.zh: 什么把甲床和甲母质连接到下面的骨头上？

explanation.en: Specialized ligaments attach the nail bed and matrix bed to the bone. They sit at the base of the matrix and around the edges of the nail bed.
explanation.zh: specialized ligaments（特化韧带）把甲床和甲母质（matrix bed）连接到下面的骨头上，位于甲母质根部和甲床边缘周围。

lockPoint.en: A ligament is a tough band, like a strong rope. Ligaments also hold your eight wrist bones together.
lockPoint.zh: 韧带的“韧”= 结实、拉不断，像一根结实的绳子。手腕的 8 块腕骨也是靠韧带连在一起的。

evidence.quote: Specialized ligaments attach the nail bed and matrix bed to the underlying bone.
They are located at the base of the matrix and around the edges of the nail bed.

question.en: The fold of skin overlapping the side of the nail is the
question.zh: 覆盖在指甲侧面的皮肤褶叫什么？

explanation.en: The lateral nail fold, also called the sidewall, is the fold of skin overlapping the side of the nail. The nail folds form the nail groove on each side.
explanation.zh: lateral nail fold（侧甲襞）也叫 sidewall（侧壁），是覆盖指甲侧面的皮肤褶。甲襞在指甲两侧形成 nail groove（甲沟）。

lockPoint.en: Lateral = side; proximal = near the base. Its other name, sidewall, tells you where it is.
lockPoint.zh: lateral = 侧面，proximal = 靠近根部。侧甲襞（lateral nail fold）的另一个名字 sidewall（侧墙）就说明了它的位置。

evidence.quote: also known as the sidewall, (SYD-wall) is the fold of skin overlapping the side of the nail
These folds form the nail groove (NAYL GROOV) on each side of the nail.

question.en: Compared with adults, children's nails grow
question.zh: 与成人相比，儿童的指甲生长

explanation.en: Children's nails grow more rapidly, while elderly people's nails grow more slowly. Nails also grow faster in summer than in winter.
explanation.zh: 儿童的指甲长得更快，老年人的指甲长得更慢。此外，指甲夏天比冬天长得快。

lockPoint.en: With age, parts of the matrix slow down forever. Older nails then get grooves from base to tip.
lockPoint.zh: 年纪越大，甲母质有些部位会永久减慢生长；所以老年人的指甲会出现从根部到指尖的纵向凹槽。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Structure - Factors that Affect Nail Growth

evidence.quote: Children’s nails grow more rapidly, while elderly people’s grow at a slower rate.
Nail plates grow faster in the summer than they do in the winter.
As a normal part of the aging process, parts of the nail matrix begin to permanently slow down production

question.en: Even when it looks dry and hard, the proximal nail fold is
question.zh: 即使看起来又干又硬，近端甲襞（proximal nail fold）也是

choices.en: living tissue that must not be cut.
dead tissue that can be trimmed.
the same tissue as the cuticle.
choices.zh: 与甲小皮是同一种组织。

explanation.en: The proximal nail fold is living skin. Nail technicians may gently push it back, but may never cut it. No client or doctor can give permission to cut living skin.
explanation.zh: proximal nail fold（近端甲襞）是活皮肤。美甲师可以轻轻往后推，但绝不能剪。顾客和医生都无权允许美甲师剪活皮肤。

lockPoint.en: Milady's test: if you cut deep enough, would it bleed? Yes means living skin: push back, never cut.
lockPoint.zh: Milady 的判断法：假如剪得够深，会流血吗？会，就是活皮肤：只能推，绝不能剪。

evidence.quote: Even if this skin appears dry and hardened, it is part of the living PNF.
Nobody, not even a doctor or a client, can give a nail technician permission to cut living skin.
If you cut deep enough into this tissue, will it bleed?

question.en: About how fast does an adult's nail plate grow?
question.zh: 成人甲板的生长速度大约是多少？

explanation.en: In a normal adult, the nail plate grows about 1/10 to 1/8 inch (2.5 to 3 mm) per month.
explanation.zh: 正常成人的甲板每月大约长 1/10 至 1/8 英寸（2.5 至 3 毫米）。

lockPoint.en: Three millimeters a month is about the thickness of two stacked U.S. pennies.
lockPoint.zh: 每月约 3 毫米，差不多是两枚叠在一起的美国一分硬币那么厚。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Structure - Factors that Affect Nail Growth

evidence.quote: The average rate of nail plate growth in the normal adult is about 1/10” to 1/8” (2.5 mm to 3 mm) per month.

question.en: Which fingernail grows the fastest?
question.zh: 哪根手指的指甲长得最快？

explanation.en: The middle fingernail grows the fastest, and the thumbnail grows the slowest.
explanation.zh: 中指指甲长得最快，拇指指甲长得最慢。

lockPoint.en: The middle finger stands tallest and its nail grows fastest. Slowest is the thumb, not the little finger.
lockPoint.zh: 中指站得最高，指甲也长得最快。最慢的是拇指，不是小指。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Structure - Factors that Affect Nail Growth

evidence.quote: The nail of the middle finger grows the fastest; the thumbnail grows the slowest.

question.en: Nail growth speeds up dramatically during
question.zh: 指甲生长在什么时候会明显加快？

choices.zh: 怀孕的最后三个月（last trimester）。

explanation.en: Hormone changes in the last trimester of pregnancy make nails grow much faster. Growth returns to normal after delivery. Prenatal vitamins are not the cause.
explanation.zh: 怀孕最后三个月（last trimester）的荷尔蒙变化会让指甲长得快很多，分娩后恢复正常。孕期维生素并不是原因。

lockPoint.en: Women take prenatal vitamins all through pregnancy. Nails speed up only in the last three months: hormones, not vitamins.
lockPoint.zh: 孕期维生素通常整个孕期都在吃，指甲却只在最后三个月猛长：原因是荷尔蒙，不是维生素。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Structure - Factors that Affect Nail Growth

evidence.quote: Nail growth rates increase dramatically during the last trimester of pregnancy because of hormonal changes in the body.
It is a myth that nail growth is caused by taking prenatal care vitamins

question.en: About how long does it take to replace a whole fingernail plate?
question.zh: 整片手指甲板完全长新大约需要多久？

explanation.en: A fingernail plate is fully replaced in about four to six months. Toenail plates take nine months to one year.
explanation.zh: 手指甲板大约四至六个月完全长新。脚趾甲板需要九个月至一年。

lockPoint.en: Check it with growth speed: about 3 mm a month for five months is roughly one whole fingernail.
lockPoint.zh: 用生长速度来验证：每月约 3 毫米，五个月差不多就是一整片手指甲。

evidence.quote: Ordinarily, complete replacement of the nail plate takes about four to six months.
Toenail plates take nine months to one year to be fully replaced.

question.en: The thickness, width, and curvature of the nail plate are determined by the
question.zh: 甲板的厚度、宽度和弧度由什么决定？

explanation.en: The length, width, and curvature of the matrix determine the thickness, width, and curvature of the plate. A longer matrix makes a thicker plate.
explanation.zh: matrix（甲母质）的长度、宽度和弧度，决定了甲板的厚度、宽度和弧度。甲母质越长，甲板越厚。

lockPoint.en: That is why toenails are thicker: their matrix is longer. No product can make a nail grow thicker.
lockPoint.zh: 所以脚趾甲更厚：它的甲母质更长。任何产品都不能让指甲长得更厚。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Structure - Factors that Affect Nail Growth
Nail Structure - Factors that Affect Nail Growth

evidence.quote: The length, width, and curvature of the matrix determine the thickness, width, and curvature of the plate.
they are thicker because the toenail matrix is longer than the matrix found on fingernails
Nothing can make the nail plate grow thicker

question.en: A healthy nail's water content is about
question.zh: 健康指甲的含水量大约是多少？

explanation.en: A healthy nail may look dry and hard, but it holds 15 to 25 percent water. The lower the water content, the more rigid the nail becomes.
explanation.zh: 健康的指甲看起来干硬，但含水量在 15% 至 25% 之间。含水量越低，指甲越僵硬。

lockPoint.en: Oil or polish on the plate slows water loss, so the nail stays flexible.
lockPoint.zh: 在甲板上涂护甲油或指甲油，可以减少水分流失，让指甲保持柔韧。

evidence.quote: A healthy nail may look dry and hard but has a water content of between 15 and 25 percent.
The lower the water content, the more rigid the nail becomes.
Using an oil-based nail conditioner or nail polish to coat the plate can reduce water loss
